## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visual changes. Add mobile viewport screenshots if layout is affected.

## Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] Semantic HTML used (native elements before ARIA)
- [ ] Fully keyboard-operable, no keyboard traps
- [ ] Visible focus states preserved
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA
- [ ] Images have appropriate `alt` text (or `alt=""` if decorative)
- [ ] Form inputs have associated labels
- [ ] Spot-checked with a screen reader, or noted below why not

## Testing Notes

How did you verify this works? (browser/device tested, screen reader used, etc.)

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format` applied
